import tempfile
import config_diff_analyzer

import os
import tempfile
import config_diff_analyzer


def _make_tree(base, structure):
    for relpath, content in structure.items():
        full = os.path.join(base, relpath)
        os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(full), exist_ok=True)
        with open(full, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            f.write(content)


def test_extra_skip_excludes_directory():
    """extra_skip should exclude a directory not in the default skip list."""
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
        _make_tree(tmp, {
            "conf/app.conf": "key1 = value1\n",
            "myvendor/app.conf": "key2 = value2\n",
        })
        files = config_diff_analyzer.discover_config_files(tmp, extra_skip="myvendor")
        relpaths = [f["relpath"] for f in files]
        assert any("conf/app.conf" in r for r in relpaths)
        assert not any("myvendor/app.conf" in r for r in relpaths)


def test_extra_skip_multiple_dirs():
    """extra_skip should handle multiple comma-separated directories."""
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
        _make_tree(tmp, {
            "conf/app.conf": "key1 = value1\n",
            "dirA/app.conf": "key2 = value2\n",
            "dirB/app.conf": "key3 = value3\n",
        })
        files = config_diff_analyzer.discover_config_files(tmp, extra_skip="dirA,dirB")
        relpaths = [f["relpath"] for f in files]
        assert any("conf/app.conf" in r for r in relpaths)
        assert not any("dirA/app.conf" in r for r in relpaths)
        assert not any("dirB/app.conf" in r for r in relpaths)


def test_extra_skip_none_preserves_default():
    """extra_skip=None should preserve default behavior (no extra exclusions)."""
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
        _make_tree(tmp, {
            "conf/app.conf": "key1 = value1\n",
            "custom/app.conf": "key2 = value2\n",
        })
        files_none = config_diff_analyzer.discover_config_files(tmp, extra_skip=None)
        files_default = config_diff_analyzer.discover_config_files(tmp)
        relpaths_none = [f["relpath"] for f in files_none]
        relpaths_default = [f["relpath"] for f in files_default]
        assert relpaths_none == relpaths_default
        assert any("custom/app.conf" in r for r in relpaths_none)


def test_extra_skip_does_not_remove_default_skips():
    """extra_skip should add to defaults, not replace them."""
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
        _make_tree(tmp, {
            "conf/app.conf": "key1 = value1\n",
            "build/app.conf": "key2 = value2\n",
            "custom/app.conf": "key3 = value3\n",
        })
        files = config_diff_analyzer.discover_config_files(tmp, extra_skip="custom")
        relpaths = [f["relpath"] for f in files]
        assert any("conf/app.conf" in r for r in relpaths)
        assert not any("build/app.conf" in r for r in relpaths)
        assert not any("custom/app.conf" in r for r in relpaths)
